title: [Dispute] JSP-000007 — Review of the concurrent FrenzyMath formalization

labels.name: wontfix
labels.description: This will not be worked on

body:
### Candidate or award and related records

JSP-000007 — Poincaré conjecture, Lean formalization.  Current candidate: https://github.com/TheJustinSunPrize/awards/issues/5558  Candidate register: https://github.com/TheJustinSunPrize/awards/blob/main/candidates/README.md

### Relevant dates

2026-09-27: Public submission of arXiv:2609.33842.  2026-09-28: Public announcement of the FrenzyMath formalization and recorded successful Comparator verification.  2026-10-06: Public submission of FrenzyMath's arXiv:2610.08329.  2026-11-11: Start of the public review for JSP-000007.

### Disputed claim

I would like to request a formal review of the priority, attribution, and eligibility assessment for the current JSP-000007 Lean formalization candidate.

A separate team, FrenzyMath / PKU@AI4Math, also completed and publicly documented a substantial Lean 4 formalization of the Poincaré conjecture during the same period.

Their work includes not only the formalization of the final theorem but also extensive reusable mathematical infrastructure, systematic organization of Lean libraries, mathematical review, and detailed verification evidence.

I am concerned that this concurrent contribution is not adequately represented in the current public candidate and attribution records.

I respectfully request a transparent comparison of the two formalizations, including their earliest verifiable complete versions, verification evidence, mathematical scope, and attribution.

This objection does not allege misconduct by the current candidates or assert that FrenzyMath has already established priority.

### Evidence and requested resolution

**Evidence**

1. FrenzyMath formalization paper:
https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08329

2. Main project repository:
https://github.com/frenzymath/Poincare-Conjecture

3. Formal proof repository:
https://github.com/frenzymath/PoincareConjecture

4. Public announcement:
https://frenzymath.com/news/poincare-formalization/

5. Comparator and Lean verification evidence:
https://github.com/frenzymath/Poincare-Conjecture/blob/main/archive/PoincareConjecture/references/ricci-flow/mapher/integration-verification/README.md

6. Source provenance and attribution documentation:
https://github.com/frenzymath/Poincare-Conjecture/blob/main/PoincareConjecture/MODIFICATIONS.md

**Requested resolution**

I respectfully ask the organizers to:

1. Conduct and document a comparative priority review of both formalizations, using fixed source revisions and independently verifiable public evidence.

2. Clarify the verification evidence and eligibility assessment supporting the current candidate.

3. Review the mathematical and formalization contributions of the FrenzyMath team, including the roles of its authors and acknowledged mathematical reviewers.

4. Add appropriate references to the FrenzyMath formalization in the public JSP-000007 record.

5. Clarify whether FrenzyMath's explanatory materials may also be considered under the Exposition category.

6. Ensure that any material objection is resolved before final confirmation of the affected award category, in accordance with the published review rules.

My purpose is to support a fair, transparent, and evidence-based evaluation of the contributions made by both teams.

### Conflicts and reviewer recusal

I have no known conflicts of interest to disclose and am not requesting the recusal of any particular reviewer.
